name: One Night Alive
source:
During a nighttime visit to your cousin's grave, you hear a voice that sounds like it's coming from.. beneath the ground?

Spend a little time getting to know (flirting with >.<) a noble man born in the Georigian era.

Who knows? Maybe the best companions are met in the places you'd least expect.

[From [url=https://snowpal.itch.io/one-night-alive]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在夜间拜访你表弟的坟墓时，你听到一个声音，听起来像是来自……地下？

花一点时间去了解（与 >.< 调情）一位出生于格鲁吉亚时代的贵族。

谁知道？也许最好的伴侣会在你最意想不到的地方遇到。

[来自[url=https://snowpal.itch.io/one-night-alive]itch.io[/url]]
